title: Single-threaded sequential server (one connection at a time)
evidence: src/server.c:77-82 accept loop calls serve() then close() inline; README.md notes 'handles one connection at a time'
suggestion: Acceptable for the spec; note that concurrent clients block. Not a requirement.

title: PUT replaces the whole record rather than patching fields
evidence: src/books.c:281 UPDATE sets all four columns; omitted optional fields become null (test_books.c:32-33 asserts isbn:null after PUT)
suggestion: Matches full-replace PUT semantics and is documented in README; no action needed.

title: Flat JSON parser rejects nested objects/arrays in the body
evidence: src/books.c:119 parse_value returns -1 for nested structures; only string/number/null/bool values are supported
suggestion: Sufficient for the flat book schema; would need extension if the model ever gains nested fields.
